title: 교육감 소속 지방공무원 인사교류 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00002:part:1/1

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (8) Omitted.

(9) The Rules on Personnel Exchanges of Local Public Officials under Superintendents of Education are partially amended as follows:

In Article 1 and the title of Article 3, "Ministry of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Ministry of Education", respectively.

In Article 3 (1), "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education", and "Ministry of Education, Science and Technology Personnel Exchange Council for Local Public Officials" shall be replaced with "Ministry of Education Personnel Exchange Council for Local Public Officials".

In Article 3 (2), "First Vice Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Vice Minister of Education", "Senior Executive Service of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology" with "Senior Executive Service of the Ministry of Education", and "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" with "Minister of Education".

In Article 4 (1), Article 7 (1) and (2), and the former and latter parts of Article 8 (1) and (2), "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education", respectively.

In Article 5, "appointed by the Minister of Education, Science and Technology from among public officials belonging to the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "appointed by the Minister of Education from among public officials belonging to the Ministry of Education".

(10) through (61) Omitted.
